risks.title: NFC payment card emulation enabled with requireDeviceUnlock=false
risks.evidence: res/xml/apdu_service.xml: requireDeviceUnlock=false; 7 AIDs including the EMV PPSE 325041592E5359532E4444463031; service vn.com.vng.zalopay.miniapp.api.v2.visa.VisaHostApduService
risks.impact_if_confirmed: a contactless transaction can be initiated while the device is locked, which removes the 'unlock before pay' user-intent barrier that EMVCo recommends for HCE wallets
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: on a lab device, present an NFC reader while the screen is locked and observe whether the HCE service establishes a session before authentication

risks.title: requestLegacyExternalStorage on a targetSdk-36 build
risks.impact_if_confirmed: the attribute is ignored for targetSdk>=30 unless scoped-storage is opted out at runtime; still signals legacy file handling paths inside the app
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: confirm whether any code reads external storage without MediaStore/SAF

risks.title: cleartext HTTP permitted app-wide, no pin-set in platform network config
risks.evidence: res/xml/network_security_config.xml: base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted=true; 0 <pin-set> elements; no certificate-transparency block
risks.impact_if_confirmed: any code path that does not go through the pinned OkHttp client (a WebView, a native client, an SDK-owned stack) is free to speak plaintext HTTP
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: resolve every Socket/HttpURLConnection/WebView usage and diff its host allow-list against the pinned client's; a dynamic proxy run would settle it

risks.title: 7 AIDs in one HCE group includes a catch-all Visa prefix
risks.evidence: res/xml/apdu_service.xml: aid-filter A000000003 (3-byte prefix) sits beside the specific A0000000031010/2010/2020/3010
risks.impact_if_confirmed: the 3-byte AID widens SELECT matching to the entire Visa range, so unlisted Visa applets also resolve to this service
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: verify with an APDU trace whether the 3-byte filter is reachable given AID priority

risks.title: Alipay AppX mini-app bundles execute remote-equivalent JavaScript
risks.evidence: assets/Griver/*.amr are AppX containers (appx/js 1.67 MB, worker 1.37 MB) with CERT.json holding only digests; 3 packages, uid 66666692/66666693/68687209
risks.impact_if_confirmed: 1.67 MB of JS runs inside the app's WebView container with a JS bridge; the trust boundary is the bridge surface, which must be permission-gated on every call
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: enumerate @JavascriptInterface methods and check each one's authorisation gate

risks.title: 5 debug/tooling components exported in a release build (4 androidx.test/Compose + 1 Google Tag Manager)
risks.impact_if_confirmed: debug-only scaffolding is reachable by other apps; typically harmless but it shows the release variant was not stripped of androidTest dependencies
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: launch each component from adb on a lab device and observe behaviour

risks.title: 32-bit-only native split (armeabi-v7a) with a 57.5 MB payload
risks.evidence: config.armeabi_v7a.apk is the only ABI split; no arm64-v8a or x86_64 split in the bundle
risks.impact_if_confirmed: on 64-bit-only devices (Play requirement since 2019) the app cannot install from this bundle; the 32-bit JNI surface also loses the benefit of arm64 hardening (BTI/PAC)
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: confirm the ABI set on the Play listing rather than a third-party mirror

risks.title: Self-signed 25-year signer certificate with no organisational identity
risks.impact_if_confirmed: normal for Android: the certificate is an app identity, not a PKI identity. Documented so the signer fingerprint can be pinned by defenders.
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: n/a — informational. Cross-check the fingerprint against Play App Signing

risks.title: Anti-analysis probes present in native eKYC library
risks.evidence: libtrueidlib.so: frida-agent/re.frida.server, de.robv.android.xposed, TracerPid, /data/adb/magisk, /sbin/.magisk, vaultCheckIntegrity, vaultCheckDebugger
risks.impact_if_confirmed: the eKYC path actively resists instrumentation — good for the vendor, and the reason this study stays fully static
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: n/a — the probes are the control, not a weakness

risks.title: Third-party SDK data collection breadth
risks.evidence: AppsFlyer (430 cls), Meta Audience Network (3,622 cls), Firebase/Measurement, AD_ID + ACCESS_ADSERVICES_* permissions, client_tracking.json (146 KB)
risks.impact_if_confirmed: advertising identifiers plus behavioural events leave the device; lawfulness depends on consent flow, which is not statically decidable
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: audit the consent gate that guards SDK initialisation (AppTrackingConsent / TCF string)

risks.title: Pinned RSA key does not authenticate the shipped config payloads
risks.evidence: 18 hash/padding combinations over both assets/config/*.json payloads, 0 valid; key SPKI SHA-256 6c4d7f0f…
risks.impact_if_confirmed: the pinned key guards runtime-fetched config; the bootstrap copy relies on the APK signature instead. This is a design choice, stated so nobody assumes otherwise
risks.how_to_confirm_or_refute: capture a live config push and verify the signature over the fetched body

risks.title: Obfuscation is aggressive but reversible in principle
risks.evidence: 45.73% of classes sit in relocated 1-3 char packages; 20 DEX files; source-file attribute stripped for 52,713 of 63,827 classes
risks.impact_if_confirmed: the Java layer resists casual reading; the native layer keeps readable rodata, so strings remain the cheapest entry point for an analyst (and for an attacker)

disclaimer: Static analysis yields hypotheses. Every entry names the experiment that would confirm or refute it; none has been executed here.
